## 3. Truncation check (FLORES): mean chrF++ change (fine-tuned − zero-shot) by reference-length quartile

| ref_len_quartile   |   mean_delta_chrfpp |   n |
|:-------------------|--------------------:|----:|
| (5.999, 14.0]      |               -1.9  | 258 |
| (14.0, 18.0]       |               -1.6  | 250 |
| (18.0, 23.0]       |               -2.13 | 258 |
| (23.0, 55.0]       |               -2.13 | 246 |

A delta that grows more negative with length suggests fine-tuning specifically hurts long multi-clause sentences; a flat pattern means truncation is not a systematic effect.
